name: autoweb
description: A browser automation plugin for Claude Code: one saved login, parallel browser lanes, a merge of their state, goals and runs per project, and nothing shared between projects.

plugins.name: autoweb-loop
plugins.description: Keeps a Claude Code session working on an AutoWeb goal until every assertion passes or an iteration cap is hit. Requires the autoweb plugin. Experimental: not yet proven in a live session.
